scenicChapters.title: Top of the Rockies Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

facts.v: Top of the Rockies Scenic Byway

collegiate-peaks-scenic-byway.story: A one-way ride of 200 km, Salida to Leadville - roughly 2 h 42 in the saddle. The stops in between: Buena Vista and Twin Lakes. The highest point is about 3,450 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

trollstigen-geiranger-golden-route-arc.title: Trollstigen · Geiranger Golden Route · short arc

waypoints.name: Åndalsnes
waypoints.advice: Åndalsnes is where the day begins. Next is Trollstigen viewpoint, climbing 848 m.

waypoints.name: Trollstigen viewpoint
waypoints.advice: You top out at 858 m here. The road climbs 848 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Valldal, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Valldal
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 263 km. You lose 838 m on the way down to it, steadily.

sections.advice: Åndalsnes → Trollstigen viewpoint climbs about 848 m in 15 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Trollstigen viewpoint → Valldal drops about 838 m over 34 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 81 km. 848 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: 182 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

trollstigen-geiranger-golden-route-arc.story: 263 km one way from Åndalsnes - plan on about 5 h 21 of riding. The climb of the day is Trollstigen. It tops out at 858 m. Trollstigen is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
